    m.addConstr(2.39 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.87 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.74 * vars['Var_3'] + 7.78 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.19 * vars['Var_6'] + 1.37 * vars['Var_7'] + 1.83 * vars['Var_8'] <= 153.13, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(3.84 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.32 * vars['Var_1'] + 6.66 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.62 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.31 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.62 * vars['Var_7'] + 7.49 * vars['Var_8'] + 0.67 * vars['Var_9'] <= 85.79, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(8.29 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.84 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.24 * vars['Var_2'] + 2.34 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.81 * vars['Var_6'] + 5.39 * vars['Var_7'] + 3.13 * vars['Var_8'] + 4.69 * vars['Var_9'] <= 110.22, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(2.24 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.57 * vars['Var_2'] + 9.87 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.96 * vars['Var_4'] + 5.44 * vars['Var_6'] + 0.04 * vars['Var_7'] + 9.48 * vars['Var_9'] <= 170.36, name='C5')
